item.title: Stargaze: SpaceX's Space Situational Awareness System
item.description:
📝 This platform has been in a “closed beta” with over a dozen participating satellite operators, allowing low-latency ephemeris sharing and conjunction screening. This ensures that operators have low-latency access to the best available data for conjunction assessment. This is particularly true for operators with maneuvering vehicles.
🔗 Read more: https://starlink.com/updates/stargaze
